resources.string: Safe mode is on: third-party plugins are removed and the app keeps its own plugins. The repair command is on the clipboard; open the console and paste it. Restart the app to apply safe mode.
The repair command is on the clipboard, including this failure.
Could not copy the repair command (the system clipboard is unavailable). Open the console and run the safe-mode command shown there.
Tap Start in safe mode below: it removes only third-party plugins, keeps this app plugins, and copies a repair command with the failure text.

Interface plugins did not load (%1$s). Automatic fallback was tried. If it still fails, tap Start in safe mode below: it removes only third-party plugins, keeps this app plugins, and copies a repair command with the failure text.
No usable WebView engine on this device (missing, disabled, or updating). Install or update Android System WebView and try again.

If startup fails, tap Start in safe mode: it removes only third-party plugins, keeps this app plugins, and copies a repair command with the failure text. You can also run the safe-mode command in the console.
New APK %1$s found (current %2$s, %3$s). Tap Download to fetch and install.
Downloading %1$s (%2$s) from the mirror chain; keep the app in the foreground
Install-unknown-apps permission is required; the settings page is open. Return after granting and the install continues.
Install-unknown-apps permission was not granted. The APK is downloaded; grant it and tap the button again.
The system installer is open; reopen the app after installing
This system has no install-unknown-apps settings page. Allow this app to install apps in system settings, then tap the button again.
Storage state has not been checked; tap to check now
Storage write failed; tap to copy the details
Storage is ready; nothing to do
Failure details copied; paste them into your report
No failure details to copy yet
Local AI tasks you can watch and control
No log to copy yet (the engine has not written engine.log)
Engine task status, pending questions, and file export results
Notification permission is needed: when the engine asks a question or waits for approval, only a notification brings you back (the task waits forever). Without it these alerts stay in the app.
Notification permission is not granted: engine questions and approval requests will not reach the notification shade; they stay in the app.
Lets the AI read the screen semantically and operate controls

When enabled, the AI can read the current screen controls (text, description, position) and tap, type, or scroll. It only works while you keep it on, stops as soon as you turn it off, and also requires a session in full-access mode.
The local engine port is used by another program; this app did not stop it. Close the conflicting app and tap Retry, or restart the device. [port-foreign]

The app cannot write its private runtime folder. Public file access does not fix this. Restart the device and reopen the app; if it still fails, open the console and copy the log. Safe mode only removes plugins and cannot repair folder permissions. [private-storage-denied]
The device reports low storage. Free some space, then tap Start in safe mode; that button only removes plugins and frees no space. Do not clear this app data. [storage-full]
The runtime or a required plugin is not ready. Open the console and copy the log for the reason; safe mode keeps the existing recovery entries. [runtime-unavailable]
The startup failure cause is not known yet. Open the console or copy the log and report it; you can also try safe mode to remove third-party plugins temporarily. [start-unknown]
Diagnostics %1$s ready; choose an app to send it to
